tests.reason: The generated manifest did not expose contractVersion before the source graph was extended.

tests.name: Contract, Host Remote Event, Host stream, TLS carrier, and carrier protocol suites

acceptance: One source graph owns authenticated unary payload.args envelopes, NDJSON requests and frames, Remote Event downlink and result variants, structured errors, and successful void outcomes.
The Host ready frame supplies the authoritative clientId, and generated result fixtures correlate clientId and eventId with next, result, void, or rejected outcomes.
Session records carry monotonic sequence numbers; snapshot cursor and replay semantics are machine-readable.
Link protocol, contract, and Session format versions are independent, and link/describe exposes contractVersion.
Compatibility rules record ignored unknown optional fields, preserved unknown Session event types, and rejected missing required fields.
Generated fixtures pass through the real Gateway Remote Event parser, Connection-backed unary carrier route, and NDJSON carrier route.
The Gateway keeps its local wire parser to avoid a Gateway to Contract to Controller workspace cycle; fixture consumption proves byte equivalence without creating a second owner.
knownLimitations: This checkpoint defines and proves Host wire equivalence. Fresh-pair ownership, native Remote Event consumption, TLS pin enforcement, reconnect, and real Host-to-native acceptance remain blocking work in G1-APPLE, G1-ANDROID, and G1-E2E.
